'''Signaler''' was a [[subnode]] created by [[Kud'ar Mub'at]] to assist him. Signaler had glowing [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that guided [[Starship/Legends|starships]] approaching the [[Ghostling Nest of the Assembler]].<ref name="EGTAS" /> One of its main priorities were to notify Kud'ar Mub'at when a foreign ship was approaching his web.
